title: EARLY MORNING WARFARE PRAYERS & DECLARATIONS
text: Before the sun rises tomorrow morning, before the city wakes up, before the noise starts, before the phone lights up with the world's agenda, before the enemy has had time to assemble the day's strategy against you, >> [music] >> there is a window, a thin, sacred, unrepeatable window between the end of the night and the start of the day where something happens in the spirit realm that most believers sleep through, where the gates of the day are still open, [music] where the agenda of the hours has not yet been written by the enemy's hand, where God is moving >> [music] >> and the one who meets him in that window does not just pray, they set the terms of the day. And the enemy knows about this window, which is why he works so hard to keep you asleep during it. >> [music] >> Which is why he makes the bed warm, which is why he makes the night feel short, which is why he fills the night with exhaustion so that the morning feels like something to survive, not something to seize. But today everything changes because by the time this word ends, you will know exactly what to pray before sunrise. You will know why the pre-sunrise hour is the most strategically significant hour of the day. You will know the specific prayer, the specific content that makes principalities and powers tremble when they hear it coming. Not because of the volume of your voice, not because of your spiritual rank, but because of who you are addressing and because of what you are establishing before the day can write its own story over your life. Before we go one step further, share this word right now, >> [music] >> not at the end, now, because there is someone you know who has lost the morning. They used to pray in the morning. They used to meet God before the day started, >> [music] >> but something happened, a season of discouragement, a prolonged unanswered period, >> [music] >> and the morning prayer quietly died, and they have been wondering why their days feel like they're already behind before they have even started, send them this word. Tell them the morning window is still open and God has been waiting there for them. >> [music] >> Now, I want to take you through the scripture foundation for the priest on rise prayer. Not one verse, a pattern. >> [music] >> Because the God of the Bible is a God who establishes patterns. And when something appears [music] as a pattern across multiple books, multiple eras, multiple lives, >> [music] >> it is not coincidence. It is principle. Pattern one, the morning is God's first. Psalm chapter five, verses one through three. >> [music] >> Give ear to my words, oh Lord, consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God, for unto thee will I pray. My voice shall thou hear in the morning, oh Lord, in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. >> [music] >> In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Two things happen in this verse that most people miss. The first is the word direct. The Hebrew is a rack, to arrange, to set in order, to marshal, to lay out in sequence. It is the same word used for a soldier arranging his battle formation before the fight. David is not saying in the morning I would talk to God about whatever is on my mind. He's saying in the morning I will arrange my prayer, I will set it in order, I will marshal it like a military formation. I will go to God in the morning with deliberate, prepared, intentional prayer. This is the first secret of the priest on rise prayer. It is not casual. It is not spontaneous. It is directed, >> [music] >> arranged, intentional. The second thing is and we look up. After arranging the prayer, he looks up. He expects an answer. He does not pray and walk away. He prays and then he watches the horizon. He arranges the prayer toward God, and then he lifts his eyes to see what God will do. This is expectant morning prayer. Not just venting upward, but arranging a petition and waiting with eyes open. Pattern two. Jesus himself prayed before sunrise. Mark chapter 1 verse 35. >> [music] >> And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed. Hear this. Jesus, the son of God, the word made flesh, the one in whom all the fullness of the Godhead dwelt bodily. Rose before sunrise to pray. Not after the disciples woke up, not after breakfast. A great while before day. Before the sun came up, before anyone else in Capernaum was stirring. He rose and he went out and he prayed. >> [music] >> Now, here is the question that most preachers never ask. If Jesus is the son of God, why did he need to pray before sunrise? >> [music] >> The answer carries the entire weight of this word. Jesus did not pray before sunrise because he was spiritually weak. He prayed before sunrise because he understood something about the spiritual mechanics of a day. He understood [music] that the morning hours carry a specific kind of access. A kind of access that is not available in the same way at noon. Not available in the same way at evening. The pre-sunrise window is architecturally [music] different in the spirit realm. And if the son of God who had more spiritual authority than any human being prioritized [music] the pre-sunrise prayer, what does that tell you about what you and I are leaving on the table? Every morning we sleep through it. Pattern three. The morning is when God's mercies are fresh. Lamentations chapter 3 verse 22 and 23. >> [music] >> It is of the Lord's message that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. New every morning. The messages of God are not recycled from yesterday. They are not leftovers from last week's prayer. >> [music] >> They are fresh, newly issued, newly available, newly dispensed. Every morning a new batch of mercy. Every morning a new allocation of compassion. Every morning heaven opens a fresh account and places everything you need >> [music] >> for that day's battles into it. There are dimensions to this that the average believer has never accessed [music] because most believers go to God to ask for mercy that was issued yesterday. They are drawing from a stale account. >> [music] >> But the pre-sunrise prayer meets the fresh mercy at the point of its release. You arrive at the throne exactly when the new batch arrives and you receive it fresh, full, and at full strength. >> [music] >> Pattern four the morning is when God speaks with clarity. Isaiah chapter 50 verse four. The Lord God had given me the tongue of the learned that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakened morning by morning. He wakened my ear to hear as the learned. He wakened morning by morning. He wakened my ear to hear. God wakes the ear. He opens the receptive faculty of the spirit morning by morning. This is not a single experience. It is a daily practice. Morning by morning the ear is opened. Morning by morning the tongue of the learned is given. Morning by morning you receive what you need to say to the weary person you will meet that day. The pre-sunrise prayer is not just about protection. >> [music] >> It is about instruction. It is about receiving from God what you need to do and say before the day begins to make its demands. >> [music] >> Thus said the spirit of God, the reason many believers feel reactive all day, responding to circumstances instead of governing them, is because they missed the morning briefing. They left the house without [clears throat] their assignment for the day. They went into the battle without the morning word. The pre-sunrise prayer is the briefing room where you receive your instructions before you enter the field. Pattern five, [music] the morning is when the enemy's plan is still forming. Hear me, this is not theology. This is encounter. In the spirit realm, the enemy assigns demonic forces to each day. He assigns spirits to the day's agenda, the people you will meet, the decisions you will make, >> [music] >> the circumstances he intends to use against you. And those assignments are fully operational by the time the day is underway. But before sunrise, the assignments are being assembled. The enemy's strategy for your day is not yet fully deployed. And the believer who prays before sunrise prays into a window where the enemy's plan has not yet fully formed. >> [music] >> You can dismantle an assignment before it is operational. You can bind what has not yet been loosed. You can establish the divine agenda before the enemy has finished writing his. This is why the enemy fights the morning prayer so hard. It is not just that he wants you to miss the blessing of the morning. It is that he knows if you get up and pray before sunrise, his plans for your day are in serious trouble. >> [music] >> You are dismantling his strategy before he has launched it. Job chapter 38:12-13, God speaking to Job, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the day spring to know his place >> [music] >> that it might take hold of the ends of the earth that the wicked might be shaken out of it? >> [music] >> Hast thou commanded the morning that the wicked might be shaken out of it? God is showing Job, and through Job, every believer that the morning can be commanded. That when the righteous command the morning, the wicked are shaken out of it. The enemies plans are disrupted. The dark spirits assembled for the day lose their grip. This is what the pre-sunrise prayer does. It commands the morning. It shakes the wicked out of the day before the day has started. And it sets the terms, God's terms, for every hour that follows. I decree and declare over every life under the sound of this voice, starting tomorrow morning you command the morning. The day does not set its terms over you. You set your terms over the day. And the wicked that were assembled against your hours shall be shaken out before they can operate. Now, this is the prayer. I am going to give you the exact structure of the pre-sunrise prayer. The content that makes the enemy tremble. The specific elements in the specific order that set the terms of your day before the enemy has had time to write his version. There are seven elements to the pre-sunrise prayer. Seven because seven in scripture is the number of completion. When all seven are prayed, the day is fully covered. Element one, consecrate the morning. The first thing that happens before sunrise is consecration. You do not begin by asking. You begin by consecrating. You consecrate the morning as holy to the Lord. You declare that this day before it has taken a single breath belongs to God. Father, before this day begins, I consecrate it to you. These hours are not mine to do with as I please. They are yours given to me as stewardship. [music] I present this day as a living sacrifice. Romans 12:1 >> [music] >> holy acceptable unto you. What you want done in these hours, let it be done. What you want said, let me say it. >> [music] >> What you want avoided, give me the discernment to avoid it. This day is consecrated, it is holy to the Lord. Element two, receive the fresh mercies. Lamentations 3:22 and 23, his mercies are new every morning. Before you ask for anything, receive what has already been issued. Father, I receive the fresh mercy of this morning. The mercy that was not available yesterday because it was not yet issued. The mercy that has been prepared specifically for this day, for the challenges of this day, for the people of this day, for the decisions of this day. I receive it fully. I receive it completely. I receive it now. The mercy that covers my failures before they happen. >> [music] >> The mercy that goes before me into the rooms I will enter today. The mercy that softens what needs to be softened [music] and opens what needs to be opened. New mercy received now. Element three, apply the blood over the day. Exodus 12, when the blood was on the doorpost, the destroyer passed over. Before the day starts, apply the blood to the hours. I plead [music] the blood of Jesus over this day, over every hour, every meeting, every journey, every conversation, every decision I will make, every road I will travel. The blood of Jesus is on the doorpost of this day. No accident assigned to this day shall prosper. [music] No sickness sent into this day shall land. No witchcraft assignment released against this day shall find its [music] target. I plead the blood over my mind for this day, over my body for this day, over my family for this day, over my finances for this day. The blood is on the doorpost. [music] The destroyer passes over every hour covered. Element four, command the morning. Job 38:12, "Hast thou commanded the morning?" This is where the enemy's plans for your day are dismantled. I command this morning in the name of Jesus. I [music] speak to this day. Hear the word of the Lord. You shall not cooperate with the enemy's agenda against my life. Every assignment assembled against me for these hours I address you now. Before you are operational, you are dismantled. Every spirit assigned to disrupt my day, bound. Every spirit assigned to create accidents [music] in my day, bound. Every spirit assigned to poison my relationships in this day, bound. Every spirit assigned to waste my time and [music] scatter my focus, bound. Every spirit assigned to bring bad news into this day, to break my faith, bound. >> [music] >> I shake the wicked out of this day. Job 38:13, "Before they take their position, before they open their mouths, before they find their target, shaken out in the name of Jesus, before sunrise." And now I release the divine agenda for this day. The people I'm supposed to meet, let divine appointments be made. The opportunities I'm supposed to receive, let them be unlocked. The favor I am supposed to walk in, let it go before me. Psalm 5:12, "Thou will bless the righteous, with favor will thou compass him as with a shield." Favor as a shield, surrounding me before I enter any room. Let that favor be active in every room I will enter today. There is someone under this voice who has an important meeting today or this week. A meeting that carries weight with a person who has influence over their future. The Lord says the meeting was already in the plan before you prayed this morning. But now that you have prayed, the atmosphere of that meeting has been changed. The heart of the person you are meeting with has been prepared. The favor has gone ahead of you. Walk into that room knowing the God of the morning has already been there. I decree the outcome of that meeting will be beyond your expectation. Element [music] five, receive the morning word. Isaiah 50:2-4, "He awakeneth morning by morning. He awakeneth mine ear to hear." Before you leave the morning, receive the word for the day. Father, awaken my ear this morning. Give me the tongue of the learned. Show me what I need to know for today. The person I will meet who is weary, give me the word in season for them. The decision that is coming, give me the wisdom to make it correctly. The opportunity that will present itself, give me the discernment to recognize it. The trap that the enemy has set, give me the spiritual perception to avoid it. I receive the daily briefing from heaven. I receive the instruction for today's assignment. Not the general standing instructions, the specific word for this specific day. He who has an ear to hear, let him hear. Matthew 11:15. My ear is open. My spirit is receptive. Speak, Lord, thy servant heareth. 1 Samuel 3:10. I speak to every person who has been going through their days without direction. Reactive, scattered, [music] managing the urgent while the important waits. The Lord says you have been skipping the briefing. You have been going into the battle without your orders. And [music] a soldier without orders is a soldier who can be redirected by the enemy. I decree the morning briefing is being restored. The ear is being opened. The tongue of the land is being given. And the days that have been reactive are about to become purposeful. Element six, release angelic deployment. >> [music] >> Hebrews 1:14, "Angels are ministering spirits sent to minister to the heirs of salvation." Psalm 91:11, "He shall give his angels charge over thee before sunrise." Release your angels into the day. Father, in the name of Jesus, I release the angels assigned to my life. I release them into this day with specific assignments. Angels, go before me into every room I will enter today. Prepare the atmosphere, move the obstacles, soften the hearts, clear the path of divine appointment. Angels, protect my children today wherever they go. Cover them on the road, cover them in the school, cover them in the workplace. Let the angels of God be a wall of fire around them. Zechariah 2:2-5. Angels, guard my mind today. Every demonic [music] transmission aimed at my thought life, intercept it before it lands. Angels, guard my finances. Every devorah moving toward my resources today, stop it. 2 Kings chapter 6:17, Elisha prayed, "Lord, open his eyes [music] that he may see." And the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire. They were always there, the young man just could not see them. The angelic host is already assembled. The morning prayer releases them into their assignments. >> [music] >> There is a mother under this voice who sends her children out every morning in fear. She waves goodbye with a smile, but inside she's gripped with worry. The world feels dangerous. The roads feel dangerous. The schools feel dangerous. The Lord says to that mother, release the angels. Every morning before they leave, pray this prayer. Release the angels of God as an escort, >> [music] >> and then trust the escort. Not because the world has become safe, [music] because the angels are real. The same God who sent chariots of fire for Elisha sends them for your children. I decree angelic covering over every child connected to this prayer from this morning until their return home, they are escorted. Element seven, declare the day's outcome. This is the final element >> [music] >> and it is the one that makes the enemy tremble most because the enemy fears the believer who declares the end from the beginning. >> [music] >> Isaiah 46:3-10 declaring the end from the beginning. The enemy fears the one who speaks into the day what has not yet happened and speaks it as though it has. Romans 4:17 call it those things which be not as though they were. >> [music] >> Before the sun rises, declare the day's outcome. I declare this day is blessed. Not I hope today will be blessed. I declare [music] present tense by faith based on the character of the God who holds today. >> [music] >> I declare the favor of God precedes me into every room. I declare divine appointments have been scheduled for me today. I declare the word I need will be in my mouth at the moment I need it. [music] I declare no accident, no ambush, no unexpected attack [music] shall prosper against me today. I declare I will end this day further along than I started [music] it. I declare something good is going to happen to me today. Not because of my merit, because of my covenant. >> [music] >> Not because I deserve it, because the God of the morning has decreed it. Psalm 118:24, this is the day which the Lord hath made. Not tomorrow, not next week. >> [music] >> This day, the one you are about to enter, he made it, he built it, he designed what is supposed to happen in it. And I will rejoice and be glad in it. I decree over every person connected to this prayer, today is not an accident. Today is not random. Today was made by God for you, with you in mind, with your assignment in mind. And the one who commands the morning before the sun rises enters that day [music] as the one who set the terms, not as a passenger, as a pilot, not as someone that day happens to, as someone who happens to the day. Now, let us pray all seven elements as one complete morning prayer. Father, I consecrate this day to you. It is holy to the Lord. I receive the fresh mercy of this morning, new, full, sufficient for everything today holds. I plead the blood of Jesus over every hour, every journey, every meeting, every person. I command this morning the wicked are shaken out before they operate. I receive the morning word. Open my ear. Give me the tongue of the learned. >> [music] >> I release the angels. Go before me. Cover my family. Guard my path. And I declare, this day the Lord has made, it is blessed, it is favored, it is mine. That prayer, prayed with faith, prayed with authority, prayed before sunrise, makes the principalities assigned to your day tremble because they know what you have done. You have consecrated what they wanted to corrupt. You have received the mercy they wanted you to miss. You have applied the blood before they could land their assignment. >> [music] >> You have shaken them out before they could assemble. You have received the briefing they wanted to withhold. You have released the angels they were hoping would stay dormant. And you have declared the outcome before they could write their version. They are not facing a sleepy believer who stumbled [music] into the day. They are facing a priest who rose before the sun and set the terms. That is why they tremble. There is a young man I see him he has been losing his days. Not because he's lazy. >> [music] >> Not because he's careless, but because every day feels like it is already against him before he begins. He wakes up reactive. He wakes up behind. He spends [music] the whole day responding instead of governing. The Lord says the problem is not the day. The problem is when the day starts for you. Your day currently starts when the enemy starts it. [music] I want your day to start when I start it. And I start it before the sun rises. Rise tomorrow morning. Rise before the city. Rise before the noise and meet me in the window. I decree the days of that young man are about to completely change because the morning is being reclaimed. And the day that starts with God ends differently than the day that starts with the enemy. Father, we thank you for the morning. We thank you that you made it. You designed the pre-sunrise window. You installed the mechanism of the morning prayer. You demonstrated it in the life of your own son. Jesus rose before sunrise. And the day that followed was governed by what he received in the dark. We receive that pattern now. We receive the discipline. We receive the grace. We receive the revelation that the most important hour of our day is the one that happens before the day officially begins. Shondai tumbala ecclesia rekay shondai tumbala ecclesia shondai rekay tumbala ecclesia shondai rekay The siege is over. The morning has been reclaimed. The window is open and you now know what to do when you step into it. Walk into your favor. It has been waiting. Not in the middle of the day, in the morning before the sun rises, before the noise starts. Before the enemy assembles his strategy, the favor is waiting in the window. Your destiny is preserved by the blood, and tomorrow morning for the first time, or again after a long absence, you will rise before the sun, and you will step into the window, and you will consecrate, and you will receive, and you will apply the blood, and you will command the morning, [music] and you will receive the word, and you will release the angels, and you will declare the outcome. And the enemy who assembled his forces for your day will hear the prayer coming, and he will tremble. Not because you are powerful in yourself, because you are covered, briefed, blood applied, and angel escorted. Because you are a morning priest who commands what the wicked hope to claim, because the God of the morning, the one who rose before sunrise, himself, is standing in the window waiting. I decree this week is not ordinary. Every morning of this week, before the sun rises, you are in the window. Every day of this week ends differently than it would have, because you commanded the morning before it started. The world will notice something has changed about your days. The people around you will notice you are governing instead of reacting. The favor will be visible, the peace will be tangible, and the testimony will be undeniable. Something happened when I started praying before sunrise. The days changed, the atmosphere changed, the outcomes changed, because I met God in the window, and he was already there. Shondai ecclesia tumbala re kai shondai >> [music] >> ecclesia tumbala shondai re kai ecclesia tumbala re Shondai. It is done. The morning has been consecrated. The blood has been applied. [music] The wicked have been shaken out. The angels have been released. The day has been declared. [music] And the enemy has received his notice. Rise tomorrow. Rise before the sun. Step into the window and set the terms of your day before your day can set its terms over you. The God of the morning is waiting. He has been there all along. Amen and amen.
